signal: FloQast crossed $200M in ARR in January 2026, driven by enterprise momentum and adoption of its auditable AI agents, on top of a $100M Series E at a $1.6B valuation.

email.body1:
Aaron, saw FloQast cross $200M ARR on the back of enterprise momentum and your auditable AI agents.

Growth that fast on expansion and renewals usually means more accounts ripe to grow than the team can touch before the window passes. Our AI SDR researches, writes, and follows up autonomously, so coverage scales without new headcount: 3-5x more meetings per rep.

I built a signal play for FloQast off your hiring and tech-stack signals, and accounts showing them tend to progress about 4.4x faster. Worth 15 minutes for me to walk you through it?
email.body2:
Aaron, quick follow-up for FloQast.

On an expansion and renewals motion, the hard part is knowing which accounts are signaling intent to grow before a competitor or churn risk gets there first. Most teams spot the gap late, and recovering a renewal quarter is far harder than getting ahead of it.

Want to grab 15 minutes? I'll walk you through our pipeline model and show exactly how many expansion touches your book needs this quarter, and where the math breaks if you only add reps.
email.body3:
Aaron, last bit of proof for FloQast.

Memgraph had more in-market accounts than the team could touch and couldn't hire SDRs fast enough. They ran our AI SDR to $2.7M in pipeline, 600 replies, and 60 BANT-qualified deals in 90 days, same team, live in four weeks, every email auto-logged to their CRM.

I pulled a benchmark of how FloQast's reply rate likely compares to peer fintech teams. Want to hop on a quick call and I'll walk you through it?
email.body4:
Aaron, I'll stop reaching out on this one, but didn't want to leave you empty-handed.

If scaling expansion coverage without adding headcount isn't a priority this quarter, no problem at all. Hitting $200M ARR keeps a team busy, and timing matters more than any pitch.

Before I close your file, worth 15 minutes to walk through a one-page playbook of 3 AI-SDR plays scoped to an expansion and renewals motion? I'll tailor it to FloQast either way.
